facts.evidence: scripts/combine2_run.py:103 compares the group's own sha256 with reg['pinned_sha256'][group['path']] and appends the mismatch to `moved`, and scripts/combine2_run.py:111 raises SystemExit('refused: pinned inputs changed...') on it. A shrunken group has a different group digest, so the run REFUSES rather than recording the short set. BOUNDARY, recorded because it is part of the fact: the refusal is relative to THE REGISTRATION'S PIN, not to an intended scope -- a store partial at registration time would pin a short group and the run would then agree with it
